name: implement-lifecycle
description: Take a code change from request to merged with subagents, adversarial review from another model family, real verification and the ship command

interface.shortDescription: Implement, review, verify, and merge changes.
interface.longDescription: Run a code change from request to merged: a subagent builds it and opens a PR, another model family tries to break it, the orchestrator judges the findings and records the review on the PR, the change is run for real, and the ship command lands it.
